_comment: Manual review of the video candidates (see docs/STRIVER_VIDEOS.md). 'useA2zSheet': the takeuforward.org sheet page points this item at a different video than the problem's own lecture, so the classic A2Z sheet video (whose YouTube title names this exact problem) is used. 'exclude': no video is shown for this problem.
